correctness.rationale: On W_n={0<...<n−1}, every persistent upset U_t is a suffix. For each nonempty neighborhood A, A⊂U_t iff min A>=t, and A∩U_t≠∅ iff max A>=t. With constructive modal clauses quantifying all later worlds j, box on U_t has observable threshold B_i=min_{j>=i} max_{A∈N(j)} min A, diamond threshold D_i=min_{j>=i} min_{A∈N(j)} max A. Thus full formulas coincide under all valuations if B,D agree by induction on implication and both modal operations; differing coordinate is separated by one proposition assigned threshold t. Every independent nondecreasing B,D is realized by one {B_i,D_i} when B_i<=D_i, or two singletons {B_i},{D_i} otherwise. The final world with b=n−1>d=0 (n>=2) cannot use one neighborhood because min A<=max A. Weakly increasing n-tuples in n symbols number binom(2n−1,n), squared independently. Independently enumerated ALL 49 admissible raw frames for n=2 and 9 semantic classes, and all profile representatives n=1..4, confirming threshold clauses and claimed counts 1,9,100,1225; original code additionally covers n=5 count 15876. This does not make the all-n result computational.
